verdict.rationale: Cognee supports dataset-level bulk actions — ingesting many files/URLs in a single `.remember` call, indexing an entire GitHub org's repositories, and 'full cleanup' deletion of all data via `.forget` — which cover coarse-grained bulk operations. However there is no documented explicit batch/bulk API for arbitrary many-item operations (e.g., bulk update, bulk export, or batch processing with progress/status), and no independent evidence validating bulk throughput or reliability at scale. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-API documentation for arbitrary large item sets, batch status/progress reporting, and independent verification of bulk operation performance.
